# Paul Irving & Rachel Lynde

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — Friend of — [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) — fond of him despite him being a Yankee · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) begins her first day of teaching at the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, meeting her students—including the sullen [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) and the imaginative [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)—and dealing with minor classroom infractions. After school, Mrs. H. B. Donnell confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with pretentious demands about her children's names, but [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) cheers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up by gifting her wild orchids. Returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her day with [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)_

> In a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares amusing stories and student compositions from her teaching job. She recounts humorous classroom incidents, answers to her creative prompts, and includes compositions written by her students, notably admiring [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter about his fictional rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P9](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0009), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P26](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0026), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can go to [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts the plan and resigns her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P24](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0024), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P26](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0026), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and is shocked to hear from [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) that [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a grief-stricken night realizing her true feelings for him. In the morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote passes by and informs her that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P27](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0027)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses her wedding plans and guest list with Mrs. Lynde and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). In the following days, guests arrive to celebrate, including Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), who presents [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with Miss Patty's china dogs. On the eve of her wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Matthew's grave before joining [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on a walk home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P0](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up happily on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her life in her childhood room. Family and friends gather to prepare and celebrate, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) are married in the orchard. Following a joyful reception, the newlyweds leave for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. [Mary](../character/mary-joe.md) while their guests remain to comfort [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Mrs. Lynde.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P0](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P3](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P17](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0017)_

> During the winter at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the emotional barrier and occasional resentment she senses from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), despite their shared activities and Leslie's gift of handmade baby clothes. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his written life-book, which she realizes could be made into a great masterpiece by the right writer.
>
